fixed_target: Agreement with the released event-flood designation, not independently validated water newly appearing since P1
water_union_role: Diagnostic collapse of released permanent-water and flood classes; not a new primary result or field truth
reference_policies: Held/delivered P0 versus latest eligible before the provisional catalogue cutoff P1; neither certified dry nor established agency practice
intended_geometry_population: Both P0 and P1 match the post image's relative orbit, pass, mode, dual polarization and look direction; constellation platform may differ
geometry_qualification: Metadata compatibility does not guarantee identical pixel incidence or eliminate terrain effects
original_full_cohort_role: Preserved full-catalogue input-policy results, including geometry mismatches; not a matched-geometry performance estimate
validity_restricted_role: Post-result validity correction on existing owned support; all eligible compatible records retained; not a pristine confirmatory replication
timing_sensitivity: Listed absolute SAR-label difference <=24h; descriptive restricted cohort, not a universal validity rule
geography: International new-event evaluation with one July 2021 Dutch/German receiving episode
claim: No clear Copernicus-FM advantage over U-Net; event-specific reference sensitivity with weakened average deterioration after geometry and timing checks
